openings.claim: Link unchanged digest comparison to the unchanged evidence ledger through reference-bearing comparison receipts and an explicit claim-to-receipt dependency relation.
openings.delta: Replace discretionary transfer of comparator findings with an interface requiring every definite earliest-stage claim to depend on supplied-record receipts establishing its equal predecessors, equal inputs and unequal outputs. Ledger entries still store claims, references and uncertainty; digest comparison still establishes recorded byte equality or inequality.
openings.prediction: Joint prediction: when final-review removal breaks a supporting receipt, the linked ledger withdraws the dependent definite claim and reports the remaining supported interval, while surviving comparisons retain their values. The broken-link control can retain individually correct comparisons yet miss that their earlier claim lost support. Neither prediction is an observed effect.
openings.probe: Use the supplied script or spreadsheet to align boundaries by manifest order and dictionary definitions. Generate receipts with comparison result and supplied record identifiers; register their claim dependencies in the ledger. Report all six pairs with record references and a next available-record or dictionary check. Missing records and blank warnings imply no nonexecution; timestamp anomalies remain annotations. Cap manual inspections at twelve per pair and initial work at sixty minutes. For the twenty-minute comparison, use the two disjoint three-pair subsets. The link-broken control preserves the same comparator, ledger, ordinary record references, interval rules and limits, but omits the receipt-dependency interface and uses manual claim updating. Apply stipulated transform removals in final review, freeze both outputs, then open the sealed answer sheets. Distinguishing observations are unsupported definite claims surviving removal, interval coverage of injected boundaries and inspection counts. Defeat evidence includes withdrawn claims whose complete cited support survives, unjustified surviving certainty, or inability to finish within limits. Equal performance leaves the interface benefit unestablished; subset differences limit causal attribution.
assumptions: The supplied field dictionary permits comparable boundaries; otherwise keep the affected interval unresolved.
Receipt dependencies can be maintained within the supplied time and inspection limits.

assessment: A testable interface opening, preserving the incumbent's conservative interval rule and both stipulated parent functions. Removal-sensitive support invalidation is proposed, not demonstrated; no cause is inferred from digest inequality.

lineage.reason: Preserve comparator and ledger functions while making their evidential linking interface explicit and breakable for comparison.
